footer.transfers: Airport pickup & drop-off included with every journey.

picker.title: Choose a tour to book
picker.text: Select the experience you'd like to reserve and we'll walk you through the details.

travelersStep.title: Your group & vehicle
travelersStep.description: Your tour is entirely private — pick your group size and the vehicle you'd like, and the price updates instantly.
travelersStep.travelersHint: Infants and children count toward the group — mention ages later.

vehicle.subFixed: This package is offered with a 4x4 Jeep.
vehicle.subSingle: One private vehicle for your group
vehicle.tooManyText: For larger groups we arrange extra vehicles or a coach. Message us and we'll tailor it to your party.
vehicle.whatsappMessage: Hi WanderKartli, we're a group of {pax} for the "{tour}" tour.

datesStep.title: When are you in Georgia?
datesStep.description: Because every tour includes airport pickup and drop-off, we need your arrival and departure dates to arrange your transfers.
datesStep.flightHint: Share your flight numbers and times so we can be at the gate.
datesStep.note: A driver will meet you in the arrivals hall with a name sign, included in your price.

detailsStep.title: Your details
detailsStep.description: Just so we can confirm your booking and reach you before the trip.

reviewStep.title: Review your booking
reviewStep.description: Please check the details below. You won't be charged yet — the next step is payment.
reviewStep.name: Name
reviewStep.note: Airport pickup on arrival and drop-off on departure are included.

paymentStep.confirmDescription: Send us your trip details and we'll reply within 24 hours to confirm everything. No payment is required now.
paymentStep.fine: We only use your details to arrange this tour. Questions? Call {phone}.
paymentStep.successTitle: Thank you — your request is on its way.
paymentStep.successText: We've emailed you a confirmation and our team will get back to you within 24 hours to finalise your private tour. No payment is taken now — you'll arrange it directly with us.

summary.fine: Private tour · all prices in USD

errors.travelersMin: At least one traveler is required.
errors.travelersMax: For groups larger than {max}, please contact us directly.
errors.vehicleFit: Please choose a vehicle that fits your group.
errors.departureOrder: Departure must be on or after arrival.
errors.submitFailed: We couldn't send your request just now. Please try again, or reach us on WhatsApp.
